original_clauses.source_paraphrase: McDonald's automated drive-through system repeatedly converted customer speech into inaccurate live orders, including unwanted items and failures to accept corrections.
original_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Transactional speech interpretation must meet the accuracy and correction assurance required before it becomes an operative fulfilment representation.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Misunderstood speech was promoted into live order state despite insufficient assurance for transactional reliance, producing recurring unwanted or uncorrectable items.

original_clauses.source_paraphrase: Public reports documented orders becoming confused between adjacent drive-through lanes.
original_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Interpreted content must remain bound to the customer and lane from which it originated before fulfilment action is taken.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Order material associated with one lane was reportedly applied in another customer's lane context, demonstrating a failure to preserve target binding.

original_clauses.source_paraphrase: McDonald's ended the IBM drive-through voice-ordering pilot in June 2024 after recurring order errors had been reported across more than 100 U.S. locations, while saying it would explore other voice-AI vendors.
original_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Ending the IBM pilot was a bounded deployment response to recurring order failures; the stated plan to explore other vendors means the response did not establish a decision to end voice ordering as a category.

new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Fulfilment relies on an accurate representation of the customer’s order.

new_episodes.source_paraphrase: In June 2024 McDonald’s announced the IBM pilot would end; a July 26 shutdown deadline was reported separately.

new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A bounded vendor decision does not establish rejection of the technology category or published performance measurement.
